clean_description: Sharks in the Time of Saviors follows the Flores family in Hawaii after a young boy, Nainoa, is rescued by a shark during a family vacation. This miraculous event leads the family to believe he has been favored by Hawaiian gods, but as Nainoa grows up, his supernatural abilities create tension and division among family members. Each sibling grapples with their identity and heritage as they navigate personal struggles and the impact of their shared past.
